name: Parcel Works: Packing Simulator
summary:
Parcel Works: Packing Simulator is a first-person warehouse simulation game where players take on the role of a warehouse employee responsible for packing orders and managing daily shipping operations. Players handle packages, pack items into boxes, fulfill customer orders, and prepare shipments while earning money and experience through their work.

As players progress, they can upgrade warehouse equipment and storage capacity to improve efficiency and handle more orders. Starting with a small operation, players work toward building a more productive and profitable warehouse business through hands-on packing, inventory organization, and warehouse management.
